jobs.occupation: Analyst in Capital Planning – Help Shape the Bank’s Financial Future
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process.

More specifically, you will:

• Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections

• Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams

• Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers

• Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs

• Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables

**About You

**

• Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field

• Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English

• Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field

• Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals

Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

A hands-on, mid-level role turning benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, supporting transfer to manufacturing partners and delivering material for formulation, soil and field testing.

About Yngvi Bio

At Yngvi Bio, we are building a biological crop-protection platform based on targeted, non-living protein complexes. Our technology combines AI-guided protein design, insect genetics and microbial production. We are moving active prototypes from biological testing into scalable fermentation, formulation, soil and field validation.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on, mid-level Bioprocessing Specialist to turn benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, support transfer to manufacturing partners and deliver consistent material for formulation, soil and field testing. This individual-contributor role suits someone who has directly participated in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles and still enjoys working at the bench and bioreactor.

Key responsibilities

• Fermentation development. Plan and execute microbial batch and fed-batch fermentations, including media, feed, induction, pH, dissolved oxygen, aeration, temperature and harvest strategies.

• Protein expression and optimization. Improve recombinant protein expression, solubility, yield, product quality and robustness by linking process conditions to biological performance.

• Scale-up and technology transfer. Translate laboratory processes toward 50-1,000 L and beyond; define scale criteria, run plans, acceptance criteria and transfer packages, and support partner execution.

• Production execution. Run repeatable, traceable batches that supply characterized material for formulation, soil, greenhouse and field testing.

• Harvest and fit-for-purpose recovery. Personally perform and improve harvest, cell disruption or extraction, clarification, concentration and the minimal purification needed for testing.

• Troubleshooting, data and quality control. Use structured experiments, data analysis, in-process controls and practical quality checks to investigate deviations and connect upstream choices to recovery and lot quality.

• Documentation and collaboration. Maintain SOPs, batch records, risk assessments and transfer documentation, and work closely with scientists, formulation and agronomy colleagues, quality functions and external manufacturing partners.

You will be responsible for practical process development and execution while helping Yngvi Bio build the documentation and production discipline needed for reliable internal batches and partner transfer.

Qualifications

• Relevant experience. Typically 3-6 years in microbial fermentation, upstream bioprocess development or production-facing biotechnology.

• Hands-on fermentation. Strong practical experience setting up, running, sampling and troubleshooting microbial bioreactors.

• Recombinant protein expression. Practical experience with microbial expression is important; bacterial systems such as E. coli are preferred. You can connect process conditions to expression, solubility, quality and recovery.

• Scale-up evidence. Direct involvement in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles beyond small laboratory reactors, with the ability to explain what changed between scales.

• Production and downstream practice. Experience producing test or pilot material and personally performing harvest, extraction, clarification and basic purification or recovery.

• Education and working style. BSc, MSc, PhD or equivalent practical expertise in engineering, biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related field, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach suited to an early-stage company.

• Valuable extras. Experience expressing virus-like particles, capsid-like structures, multimeric or self-assembling proteins, or other complex recombinant proteins is a bonus. Experience with design of experiments, automation, advanced downstream processing, CDMOs or agricultural biotechnology is also valuable.

What we offer

• A role with direct influence on how Yngvi Bio turns designed proteins into repeatable, scalable production.

• Work spanning fermentation, production, scale-up and the delivery of material for formulation, soil and field testing.

• A small international team at BioInnovation Institute where you can build practical systems, solve difficult technical challenges and grow with the role.

Role details

Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen. The role is laboratory-based and may involve occasional partner or manufacturing-site travel.

Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a short application describing your hands-on fermentation, recombinant-protein production and scale-up experience to info@yngvi.bio.

Application reference: Begin the subject line or application title with Yngvi-BP26-[Surname] Application. For example: Yngvi-BP26-Nielsen Application.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

**

Do you want to immerse yourself in testing and quality assurance of large and complex software projects that help digitalise and strengthen Denmark? Are you systematic, with a keen eye for detail? Then you might be the person we are looking for as our new Test Consultant.

Responsibilities and technologies

Testing and quality assurance are a crucial part of the IT solutions we develop together with our clients. As a Test Consultant, you will help test business-critical IT systems that have an impact not only on our public-sector and private-sector clients, but on people across Danish society.

You will always be part of a project team from Netcompany, typically working together on-site with the client. In this role, you will act as the link between the client, their business needs, and our technical solution.

You will continuously develop your testing and technical skills. Throughout your projects, you will gain hands-on experience with a wide range of the latest technologies and tools.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Ensuring the quality of the solution through various types of testing

• Analysing the functional aspects of the solution

• Preparing test plans and designing and writing test cases

• Executing functional and non-functional tests

• Contributing to troubleshooting and test reporting

About you

You can work methodically and connect business and IT-related challenges, explaining business needs to developers and technical aspects to clients. In addition, we imagine that you:

• Can navigate complex error scenarios and understand complex system landscapes

• Are systematic and detail-oriented throughout the analysis, design, development, and testing phases

• Think logically and analytically, and can break down and understand complex concepts and communicate issues and gaps clearly and effectively

• Hold a relevant master’s degree

Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

With a focus on the international defense industry, Sky-Watch A/S develops, manufactures, and implements high-tech solutions in the form of drone and sensor technology. Through cutting-edge UAS technology, battle-proven products, experienced instructors, skilled technicians, and dedicated support personnel, the company delivers the best M-UAS platform and associated UAV solutions. These solutions empower decision-makers in complex and high-risk environments worldwide to make safe and effective decisions—ultimately enhancing the overall success of their missions.

Sky-Watch is dedicated to establishing relationships and ensuring visibility among key decision-makers in its target customer segments. This audience primarily consists of stakeholders at political, ministerial, general staff, and operational levels.

Founded in 2009, Sky-Watch is headquartered in Støvring and currently employs +145 people. The company culture is driven by passionate and highly skilled employees motivated by the ambition to develop technology of the highest quality, as well as a curiosity that ensures continuous product innovation and value creation.

To strengthen the Product Marketing Team, Sky-Watch is now looking for a highly skilled and driven

Product Marketing Manager

1st class product – Go-to-Market – Sales Enablement

Do you want to play a key role in shaping how a fast-growing international defence company positions, communicates and brings its products to market? As the new Product Marketing Manager at Sky-Watch you will take ownership of product and portfolio messaging, use cases, and go-to-market execution across the entire platform, ensuring clarity, credibility, and impact throughout a high-consideration B2G/defence buying process. You will join a high-tech company with market-leading UAV technology, operating in a rapidly growing and strategically important defence sector, where innovation, proactivity, and technical excellence are deeply embedded in the culture.

You will report directly to the Director of Product Marketing, and your key responsibilities will include:

• Positioning & Messaging: Own product and portfolio positioning, value propositions, and messaging frameworks across channels.

• Use Cases & Stories: Own use cases and case stories, ensuring they are reused across marketing, sales, and partner activities.

• Go-to-Market & Launches: Lead product launches, major updates, and software releases, including narratives, release communication, and enablement materials.

• Sales & Partner Enablement: Develop and maintain sales and partner enablement assets, supporting effective pitching and objection handling.

• Market & Competitive Insight: Translate customer, market, and competitor insights into clear messaging and go-to-market priorities.

• Trust & Compliance Content: Ensure procurement-facing and compliance-related content supports the buying journey clearly and consistently.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Align Product, Marketing, Sales, and partners by translating roadmap decisions into market-ready communication.

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing/Communication, Technology Management, or a related field combining commercial and technical focus. You bring at least five years of experience in B2B or B2G product or solution marketing, preferably from technology-driven, regulated, or complex industries such as defence, aerospace, or B2B SaaS. You have proven experience defining positioning and value propositions, developing go-to-market plans, and creating practical sales enablement materials in close collaboration with product management, engineering or software teams, as well as sales and channel partners. You are skilled at translating complex technical products into clear customer value and compelling narratives and are fluent in professional English.

You reside within an hour drive from the office in Støving, and you must be willing to travel approximately 30-40 days a year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. Furthermore, you are proactive and structured, and you are able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You thrive in a fast-changing environment and manage to keep calm and handle multiple products, projects and deadlines in parallel. With a strong analytical and curious mind-set, you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable plans and translate complex topics into compelling, easy-to-understand communication. jobs.occupation: Defence Business Development Lead, Space Inventor
jobs.description:
Space Inventor is looking for an experienced Defence Business Development Lead to drive business development, collaboration and sales within the defence and security market.

The Defence Business Development Lead will be responsible for identifying, developing and closing opportunities with defence customers, government organisations, procurement agencies, defence primes and strategic industry partners across Europe and internationally, with a focus on European, Nordic and Baltic regions.

The role will focus on satellite missions, constellations and space-based capabilities supporting areas such as ISR, SIGINT, Earth observation, maritime surveillance, situational awareness, secure communications and sovereign space capabilities.

This is a senior hands-on government- and customer-facing role. You will own opportunities from early market engagement and requirement shaping through RFI/RFP, proposal development, negotiation and contract award. As the business development lead, you will be supported by a cross-functional team of specialists that will help shape competitive and technically sound proposals.

A key part of the role is to engage with partners/primes and government officials before formal procurements are released. You will use your existing defence network and market understanding to identify emerging requirements, programmes and partnerships where Space Inventor's satellite capabilities can create operational value.

You do not need to be a satellite engineer, but you must have a solid understanding of the sales cycle and the ability to navigate complex sales processes. Additionally, you must be able to understand complex operational requirements and engage credibly with military, governmental, commercial and technical stakeholders.

The job is located in Aalborg or Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll report to the Mission Sales Director and work closely with both the marketing and sales teams.

Your Responsibilities

• Lead commercial negotiations covering scope, pricing, contractual conditions and programme requirements.

• Develop and grow Space Inventor's business within the European and international defence and security market, with focus on Nordics and Baltics.

• Identify and develop opportunities through an established network across Ministries of Defence, armed forces, procurement agencies, defence primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• Engage customers early to understand operational requirements, upcoming programmes and procurement plans before formal tenders are released.

• Own the commercial sales cycle from qualification through RFI/RFQ/RFP, proposal, negotiation and contract award.

• Develop strategic accounts and capture plans for priority defence programmes and customers.

• Identify and qualify local partners in the focus countries and build partnerships/consortia to address local needs and requirements.

• Monitor defence programmes, budgets, tenders, competitors and market developments to identify future opportunities.

• Maintain the defence sales pipeline, forecasts and opportunity strategies and contribute to Space Inventor's overall defence market strategy.

• Represent Space Inventor at customer meetings, exhibitions and industry events.

Qualifications

You should have strong knowledge of the defence sector, its operational environment and customer landscape, combined with a good understanding of space-based defence capabilities and their role in modern defence operations.

You do not need to be a technical space specialist, but you should be able to understand defence requirements, identify where satellite-based solutions can provide operational value and engage credibly with defence customers and Space Inventor's technical specialists.

We expect you to have:

• Significant proven experience within defence sales, business development, capture management, partnership development and complex defence solution sales.

• A successful track record of developing business with defence and governmental customers, including signed contracts and long-term strategic partnerships

• A strong and relevant existing network within the European defence industry, including relationships with defence organisations, procurement agencies, primes, system integrators and strategic partners.

• A strong international outlook and preferably an established global defence network.

• Experience engaging directly with Ministries of Defence, armed forces, defence procurement organisations or other governmental stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of B2G sales and defence procurement processes.

• Ability to understand technically complex products and communicate their operational and commercial value.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Willingness to travel frequently within Europe and internationally.

• Ability to work closely with engineers and technical specialists when developing customer solutions.

Advantageous experience:

• Previous experience within space, satellites, ISR, SIGINT, electronic warfare, surveillance, secure communications, sensors, UAVs or other advanced defence technologies.

• Previous employment with a defence prime, defence technology company, military organisation, government organisation or procurement authority.

• Experience working with NATO nations or NATO organisations.

• Knowledge of European defence initiatives, funding programmes and procurement mechanisms.

• Military or governmental defence experience.

• Experience working with classified or security-sensitive programmes.

What We Offer

• A full-time role with exposure to a variety of disciplines within space technology.

• A position in an exciting, rapidly growing industry with significant international reach.

• A chance to shape your role and responsibilities within a growing company.

• Great colleagues and several social events each year.

• Health insurance and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary and good working conditions.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, apply by submitting your CV and application. If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact us via jobs@space-inventor.com, and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

Interviews are held continuously until the right candidate is found.

Start date to be agreed, but preferably with start-up as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application.

About Space Inventor

Space Inventor is a leading Satellite company with a passion for exploring space and delivering innovative solutions in satellite technology. Our mission is to revolutionize the space industry with creativity, technical expertise, and reliability. With our 250+ years of combined experience in the space industry, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what satellites can achieve.

**Are you a technically minded professional who enjoys engaging with customers, operational users, partners, and technical decision-makers? Do you have the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions and to communicate technical value credibly?

**Join us at Falcom, part of the GN group, as our new Sales Engineer to increase our technical credibility, solution quality, and win probability in complex tactical communication and hearing-protection opportunities.

In the role of Sales Engineer in the Sales function, you will partner with Business Development Managers throughout the sales process. While the sales team manages the commercial dialogue, you will manage the technical discussions, from discovery and solution design through proposal, trial, negotiation, and handover.

**The Team You Will Be Part Of

The role combines technical depth with customer-facing communication. You will initially spend significant time with Engineering and R&D to build a comprehensive understanding of our products, technologies, and solution landscape. As your technical scope develops, you will apply this knowledge directly in sales engagements and customer opportunities.

You will be part of an evolving organization where processes, roles, and ways of working continue to develop. Your ability to create solution clarity, manage technical risks, and communicate effectively across different audiences will be important to delivering quality outcomes for our customers.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

**

• Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, field trials, and evaluations.

• Turn product capabilities into customer-relevant operational value, differentiators, and technical proof points.

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Can communicate credibly with both operational users and technical decision-makers.

• Enjoy presenting, facilitating technical discussions, and making complex information clear and relevant to different audiences.

• Bring a customer-focused approach, including the ability to listen carefully, understand operational needs, and translate them into practical solutions.

• Use structured problem-solving and industry insight to assess technical challenges, identify risks, and support high-quality customer outcomes.

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

**We encourage you to apply

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than Nov 15th. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

Due to the nature of this role and its work with tactical communication and hearing-protection solutions, the successful candidate will be required to complete a background check as part of the recruitment process. Employment is subject to satisfactory completion of the background check and any other requirements applicable to the role.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure a fair and equal application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**Built on 150 years of innovation. FalCom is built on GN Group’s foundation as a global leader in intelligent audio solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, GN delivers technology that enhances hearing and sight. We enable people to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for individuals, businesses, gamers, and tactical units.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

About the role

Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations across all parts of the Information Communication Technology (ICT) organisation? If so, this may be the right opportunity for you. You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. The team oversees compliance risks across ICT, operational risk and data governance, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies. Working closely with Compliance colleagues in Denmark and internationally, you will play a key role in strengthening compliance oversight across Saxo's technology organisation. Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across ICT areas regulated by DORA, including ICT risk management, incident management, business continuity and resilience testing, access management, critical functions and systems and third-party ICT service providers. Depending on your profile, knowledge and experience, the role may also include compliance activities within operational risk, data quality and data governance. As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities

You will join an organisation where the foundation of the business is built on ICT and where platform availability is key to help clients get invested in the world. In the Prudential Oversight Compliance Team, ICT regulation is a core focus, and you will help us support Saxo in continuously driving this important area in a compliant direction. Your main responsibilities will be to:

• Perform compliance risk assessments within the areas of ICT risks, operational risks and data risks, with a particular focus on DORA-related requirements

• Provide advice, challenge and compliance opinions to the business on regulatory requirements and compliance risks

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities, including follow-up and closure of recommendations

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to the senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing Saxo’s compliance framework

• Collaborate closely with our Compliance Team in India

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

Your profile

We are looking for a colleague with solid experience working in ICT compliance, operational risk, data governance or technology risk management. Most importantly, you have experience working with ICT requirements and legislation, ICT governance, risk assessments, and advisory work related to ICT requirements, and you are familiar with DORA or NIS2. You may have gained this experience within a second line of defence compliance or risk function, a first line of defence risk or control role within financial services, internal or external audit, IT audit, consultancy or another highly regulated industry. Experience with operational risk and data governance is considered an advantage. Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork, and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation. It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’. You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on. You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success. We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations. When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense. At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

• Do you want to become part of our Nordic Industrial Solutions team, where technical expertise, entrepreneurship, and close customer partnerships are at the heart of everything we do?

For more than 65 years, Alsiano has partnered with leading international manufacturers of raw materials and additives. We specialize in raw materials and additives for industrial applications such as plastics and elastomers, paints and coatings, industrial and institutional (I&I) cleaning products, household cleaning products, food, and healthcare.

The Role

You will be responsible for your customer portfolio in Denmark and Southern Sweden, where you will offer plastic raw materials and additives. Your focus will be on growing your existing customer base while identifying new customers and business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct customer visits to identify potential and explore new business opportunities, prepare offers, negotiate prices, and follow up on projects and sales pipelines.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have at least 3-5 years’ experience in technical B2B sales, combined with a relevant technical education. It is essential that you can effectively engage with customers, work independently, and bring a high level of energy and self-motivation.

Furthermore, you are:

• Able to balance both short-term and long-term objectives and prioritize your efforts accordingly.

• Results-oriented and motivated to achieve ambitious goals.

The position involves travel, primarily within Denmark and Southern Sweden, as well as occasional travel to other European countries, approximately 60-80 days per year.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**Build and lead Esko’s first global Strategic Accounts sales organization and change how some of the world’s biggest brands buy from us.

**Esko, a Veralto company, is a global provider of software and hardware for packaging design and print workflow, trusted by the brand owners, retailers and converters behind everyday packaged goods. We are hiring a VP, Strategic Account (B2B Software) to move our most important customers from transactional, product-led deals to consultative, value-based partnerships.

You will lead a newly formed and geographically dispersed team of 12 senior level strategic account managers across roughly 90 global tier-1 accounts, with a mandate to deliver significant new ARR alongside renewals. It is a rare chance to put your own stamp on structure, methods and talent, in a fast-evolving technology market leader aiming to scale :200% to $1B annual revenues by 2031.

The role

Based remotely in Europe or the US (50-75% global travel) and reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will build and lead Esko’s global Tier 1 Strategic Account organisation. The VP, Strategic Accounts Sales will own commercial performance across new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, recurring-revenue growth, profitability, pipeline and forecast accuracy. Each strategic account has a single global commercial owner, and you will lead the people who play that role.

We won’t pretend this brand-new role is straightforward. Esko is undertaking significant growth and transformation, with active M&A, rapid adoption of AI and a shift from on-premise licensing to cloud-based SaaS, and its commercial organisation is still maturing. You will work at pace, through real complexity and some ambiguity. If you find that energising, we would genuinely like to meet you.

What you’ll do

• Build the team and operating model. Set the structure, performance standards and governance for the Tier 1 portfolio, and coach and develop talent

• Own the number. Be accountable for bookings, ARR, new logos, retention, expansion, profitability, pipeline and forecast accuracy across around :90 parent accounts.

• Change how Esko sells. Move from product pitches to consultative, value-based selling: executive discovery workshops, quantified business-value readouts and outcome-based proposals.

• Make it repeatable. Introduce one common approach to account and pursuit planning, MEDDPICC-style qualification, opportunity management and CRM discipline.

• Shape bigger deals. Develop multi-year agreements, Enterprise License Agreements and portfolio-based commercial models.

• Be the executive face of Esko. Act as sponsor and deal strategist on major opportunities, run peer-to-peer executive sessions, and bring customer leadership into roadmap conversations.

• Orchestrate across Esko. Align Presales, Customer Success, Product, Services, Marketing, partners and Esko executives around one plan per account, and bring the customer’s voice into product and go-to-market priorities.

• Open new doors. Expand into new buying centres, business units and regions, and target white space in consumer packaged goods and life sciences.

Who we’re looking for

A global tier 1 strategic accounts sales leader who has sold software/services to the largest companies in an industry, and who has turned that experience into a repeatable system for a team.

• Led global sales teams in a recurring-revenue B2B software & services environment, with measurable ARR growth from acquisition, expansion and retention.

• Built and transformed a strategic account function within a medium or large software organization on a global/multi-regional scale

• Created and embedded modern go-to-market and a consistent strategic-selling process: value selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification, account planning and documented best practice.

• Designed multi-year strategies for complex multinational customers, led executive-level negotiation and closed complex strategic accounts sales.

• Credible with customer leadership on business strategy and roadmaps.

• Disciplined with CRM (SFDC), forecasting and pipeline management.

• Collaborative, inspiring leader who engages and aligns geographically dispersed, remote-based teams and influences Product, Finance and Customer Experience.

• Flexible to travel globally 50-75%

• Experience in packaging, branding, print technology, pre-media, digital workflow software, life sciences or consumer goods, is useful but not essential

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.

Why join

• A genuine transformation mandate. Shape the structure, methods and talent of a commercial organisation that is modernising.

• Scale and ambition. Esko is aiming for $1B in scale by 2031, and the commercial foundation you build will support faster integration of acquisitions. You will gain visibility of M&A as deals progress.

• Room to grow. You report directly to the CRO, with a route to broader commercial leadership over time.

• Executive-level work. Engage the senior leadership of the world’s best-known brands, and help connect their strategy with Esko’s roadmap, services and solutions.

• A long-term home. Esko is part of Veralto, with a long-term horizon rather than a short private-equity exit cycle. Expect real support for people, training, and career development.

**About Esko And Veralto

**Esko provides software, hardware and services that help brands, retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers and converters produce better packaging for billions of consumers. Founded in Belgium in 2002 and headquartered in Ghent, Esko touches 90% of the world’s retail packaging, serves over 25,000 customers across 140 countries, with : 1800 associates.

jobs.occupation: Technical Instructor - Offshore Operations - Maersk Training
jobs.description:
Experienced Offshore Professional from Oil & Gas, Wind, or Energy Operations? Share your operational expertise as an Instructor at Maersk Training in Svendborg. Help shape the next generation of energy professionals and contribute to safer operations worldwide.

**Recruitment managed by MARPRO Group on behalf of Maersk Training.

Maersk Training, a global leading learning provider to the maritime, oil & gas and wind industry, is expanding our offerings and growing our business within the maritime and energy industry. We are looking for a professional with frontline operational experience from the oil & gas, offshore, or wider energy industry, combined with the potential, ability, and passion to share knowledge, experience, and best practices with others.

**We Offer

**An exciting and challenging position, where you will use both your technical competence and experience, as well as your interpersonal skills. As our new Technical Instructor, you will be part of an innovative company, dedicated to developing crew competence in the maritime – and energy industry, to improve safety and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities

**The scope will be to deliver (both classroom and virtual) and develop training within the maritime and energy industry.

You will:

• Conduct high-quality courses within the maritime-, wind- and energy industry

• Take part in maintaining our advanced simulators and developing new scenarios and exercises

• Ensure timely update and upgrade of the courses you are assigned responsibility for

• Develop new courses and services to customers

• Keep an eye on technology development and industry trends within marine engineering, and share your knowledge with the instructor team and commercial

• Support our sales organisation with expert advice and technical knowledge

**Professional Competencies Required For This Role

**We are looking for a person that has:

• You have a technical background as Marine Engineer, Offshore Engineer, Technical Supervisor, Control Room Operator or similar within offshore wind, oil & gas, drilling, or other energy-related industries.

• Strong technical competence with demonstrated experience from a supervisory, operational, or training position within the offshore wind, oil & gas, drilling, or energy industries.

• Hands-on experience from offshore operations, oil & gas production facilities, drilling rigs, control room operations, or similar technical environments.

• Experience delivering training, mentoring colleagues, or developing the skills of others is considered an advantage.

• Fluent in English both verbally and in writing

Other backgrounds than above could also be relevant, so we encourage anyone with interest in the position to apply.

**Personal characteristics we are looking for

**

• Passionate about sharing knowledge and helping others develop their competence and skills

• Highly self-driven and result oriented

• Service minded and open to new tasks

• Strong desire to contribute to the team success

• Structured way of working, showing attention to detail and following procedures

• Motivated to acquire new knowledge, and use this to develop and deliver high-quality training

• Be able to work both alone managing own projects and form part of a team

**What Maersk Training Offers

**Joining Maersk Training means becoming part of a globally respected organisation dedicated to developing competence, safety, and operational excellence across the maritime and energy industries.

**As Technical Instructor, you can expect:

**

• A full-time, permanent position with long-term career opportunities

• An attractive compensation package reflecting your experience and expertise

• A daily lunch arrangement

• Access to fitness facilities and wellness benefits

• The opportunity to work in a truly international environment with colleagues, clients, and participants from across the globe

• A collaborative culture where you become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team of instructors

• The chance to work for a well-respected and reputable global brand with a strong market position and solid financial foundation

• A meaningful role where you help develop the next generation of maritime and energy professionals while contributing to safer and more efficient operations worldwide

**Application

**The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions to this position, please contact Chief Operations Manager Nanna Lyck Cerelius, MARPRO Group at +45 5370 0995.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

**About Maersk Training

**_Maersk Training is a global training and consulting organisation and part of the A.P. Moller - Maersk Group. For more than 40 years, the company has helped develop skilled, confident, and safety-focused professionals across the maritime, wind, energy, and offshore industries.

__With world-class training facilities, advanced simulators, and a strong focus on practical learning, Maersk Training partners with organisations worldwide to improve safety, operational performance, and technical competence.

__Driven by excellence, innovation, and a passion for workforce development, Maersk Training plays a vital role in preparing people and businesses for the challenges of today's and tomorrow's industries. As a Maritime Instructor, you will become part of a respected international organisation where your expertise will help shape the next generation of maritime professionals.

_We strongly encourage you to connect with MARPRO Group, to be considered for job openings that are not publicly listed. It is 100% free and confidential to join our talent pool and you can create your personal profile in few minutes.

We are your gateway to Maritime & Shipping talent. Whether you’re a maritime or logistics company seeking exceptional professionals or a skilled individual searching for the next career opportunity, we connect the right talent with the right employers. Our extensive network and industry-specific expertise ensure a seamless recruitment process, making us the preferred choice for Maritime & Shipping staffing solutions.

We have the full and exclusive mandate to all positions listed and all applications have to go via MARPRO Group.

We launched the Atlas People brand in March 2025 and have had paying customers from the outset. We now have more than €500k in ARR, are closing our third external funding round, and are running pilots with two Fortune 500 companies. Other customers include Telenor, Novonesis, Auditdata, and DTU.

Atlas helps leaders see whether their organisation can deliver a plan, where execution may slow, and what to address first. We combine our own measurement and organisational context with AI and human judgement. We are turning work usually delivered as a service into recurring software.

We are looking for someone who has built a company before, preferably from pre-seed through an exit. You will join as CCO with the ownership and judgement of a co-founder. For the right person, the role may grow into CEO over time.

Tasks

Lead major enterprise opportunities from the first meeting through agreement and expansion.

Build a qualified pipeline across several channels, with a consistent rhythm for account work.

Test our assumptions about the buyer, timing, message, and route to market, then apply what we learn.

Develop pricing, packaging, and the recurring model with colleagues in product, delivery, and finance.

Document the commercial approach and hire the first commercial colleagues when their roles are clear.

Requirements

You have built a company from pre-seed through product-market fit and into scale. We prefer someone who has founded a company and completed an exit.

You have personally led complex enterprise agreements involving senior decision-makers, procurement, and several stakeholders.

You understand pricing, packaging, expansion, ARR, and NRR in a B2B software business.

You can turn experience into a working commercial process that another person can learn and own.

You take a company-wide view and understand how commercial choices affect product, hiring, financing, and time.

You are comfortable with long enterprise cycles and keep an account moving when it goes quiet.

You can talk openly about decisions that did not work, what you learned, and what you changed.

Benefits

Meaningful ownership through warrants. We discuss equity, vesting, salary, scope, and decision rights in the first conversation.

Responsibility for the commercial model, with influence on pricing, packaging, hiring, and company design.

Close work with the founding team across customers, product, and strategy.

A live platform, our own measurement, and established customer work to build from.

A direct hand in shaping the culture as Atlas grows. We use Atlas internally to review roles, capabilities, collaboration, and engagement.

A possible path to CEO, based on the partnership and what Atlas needs.

Apply with your contact details and a short note. Put your LinkedIn profile link on the first line. You may attach any files that help us understand your work.

If we invite you to interview, we will first send you the Atlas People hiring assessment. Please complete it before your first conversation with Kevin. The next steps are a structured conversation, a short commercial exercise, a working session, references, and an offer.

About the role

Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations within financial and non-financial risk areas? If so, this may be the right opportunity for you at Saxo. You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies. Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc. As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities

• Perform compliance risk assessments

• Provide advice and compliance opinions to the business on managing compliance risks and regulatory requirements

• Conduct compliance monitoring activities

• Contribute to regular compliance reporting to senior management of the bank

• Participate in developing the bank’s compliance framework

• Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

Your profile

We are looking for a colleague with experience from working with one or more prudential risk areas, who is motivated to develop deeper expertise in these areas. Further we expect you to have:

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from the financial sector, preferably within compliance, risk management, audit, finance, credit or another relevant first-line function

• A relevant educational background within economics, finance, accounting, audit or similar

• Interest in prudential risk areas such as capital, liquidity, market risk, credit risk, model risk, strategic risk, operational risk areas, governance, and internal controls

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as CRR/CRD, Basel guidelines, EBA/ESMA guidelines, the Executive Order on Management and Control of Banks and other relevant Danish financial regulation is an advantage

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation. It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’. You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

Please note! International applicants are encouraged to apply. To help us understand your circumstances, we kindly ask candidates currently based outside Denmark to include a brief summary of their relocation plans and expected timeframe for relocating to Denmark.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on. You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success. We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations. When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense. At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply

: Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

About Saxo Bank

Support our purpose

We believe access to global capital markets is not only for the privileged few. Our vision is to enable people to fulfill their financial aspirations to make an impact. That’s why we use the power of technology to deliver clients what they need, when they need it in a user-friendly and personalised experience. We aim to deliver the world’s most user-friendly and personalized trading and investment platform experience, which gives our clients exactly what they need to make more informed investment decisions.

Be part of a unique journey

Do you want to work for an extremely ambitious organisation at the cutting edge of banking and technology? You’ll be joining a company that:

. Continuously strives to improve the Saxo Experience and exceed our clients’ expectations.

. Always invests in the future

. Builds unrivalled platforms for seasoned and experienced investors and wholesale clients that provide real-time access to global capital markets.

. Consistently wins the highest accolades for our platforms, products and services.

Own your future

So, if you’re up for the challenge of breaking down barriers in global financial markets, we’re always looking for ambitious and enthusiastic people who share our passion for clients, technology and innovation and can bring new perspectives to our diverse team. For more on our story, culture and identity, please read the Saxo Bank Foundation, written by our CEO and founder Kim Fournais.
